title: FairNVT: Improving Fairness via Noise Injection in Vision Transformers

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using prediction-level fairness metrics including Demographic Parity (DP), Equalized Odds (EO), and Equal Opportunity (EOpp). Representation-level fairness is evaluated by training a post-hoc attacker network (MLP) to predict gender from the model's embeddings. Qualitative assessments include gradient-based saliency maps (SmoothGrad) and counterfactual gender indicator swapping in text biographies.

Measured using prediction-level fairness metrics including Demographic Parity (DP), Equalized Odds (EO), and Equal Opportunity (EOpp) on image classification tasks. Representation-level fairness is evaluated by training a post-hoc attacker network (MLP) to predict age groups from the model's embeddings.
